name: Moussa Cisse
short_comment: Cisse exited Wednesday's 101-97 preseason loss to New Orleans due to a left ankle sprain.
long_comment: Cisse exited early, though Dallas head coach Dusty May downplayed the severity of the injury. "They said he tweaked an ankle and I don't think preseason is a reason to push it," May said, per source. As such, the Mavericks could opt to hold Cisse out of Friday's preseason finale against Atlanta.

name: DeMar DeRozan
short_comment: DeRozan (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
long_comment: The Nuggets' starters will all suit up versus Los Angeles, though the team will be without its top bench option. DeRozan has had a quiet preseason, averaging 4.7 points, 1.3 rebounds and 1.3 assists across 10.2 minutes per contest. However, it's reasonable to assume he will be much more productive come the start of the regular season.

name: Kris Dunn
short_comment: Dunn (rest) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Nuggets, independent Clippers reporter Joey Linn reports.
long_comment: After appearing in each of the Clippers' first two preseason games, Dunn will be sidelined Wednesday for rest purposes. The veteran guard's next chance to suit up will come in the club's regular-season opener Oct. 21 against the Kings, when he could see an elevated role with Bradley Beal (knee) ruled out for Opening Night.

name: Kobe Sanders
short_comment: Sanders (hip) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nuggets, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.
long_comment: While Sanders isn't available for the Clippers' final preseason game, the team is optimistic he will be cleared to suit up for Opening Night against the Kings. With Max Strus (foot), Bradley Beal (knee) and Brandon Ingram (Achilles) all sidelined to begin the 2026-27 campaign, Sanders might be in line for a more prominent role. The 24-year-old appeared in 68 regular-season games as a rookie in 2024-25, starting 16 of them, averaging 7.3 points, 2.3 rebounds and 1.6 assists over 19.9 minutes per contest.

name: Kylor Kelley
short_comment: Kelley (calf) did not play during Saturday's 144-128 preseason win over Brooklyn.
long_comment: Kelley signed a deal with Miami on Thursday but has yet to see any game action. His current health status hasn't been disclosed, though the big man's Summer League stint was cut short by a right calf strain that could still be a factor. Kelley's final chance to suit up during the preseason will come Friday against the Magic.

name: Kevin Porter Jr.

long_comment: Porter has appeared in two of the Bucks' preseason games. His final chance to play before the start of the regular season will come Friday against Indiana.

name: Myles Turner

name: AJ Green
short_comment: Green (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS58 reports.

name: Rocco Zikarsky
short_comment: Zikarsky (undisclosed) was unavailable for Wednesday's 128-106 preseason loss to Detroit.
long_comment: Zikarsky appeared in two of Minnesota's first three preseason games but has been unavailable for the club's past two contests. His next chance to suit up will come Friday against Chicago.

name: Enrique Freeman
short_comment: Freeman (shoulder) did not play in Wednesday's 128-106 preseason loss to Detroit.
long_comment: Freeman exited Saturday's contest against Miami due to a right shoulder injury and has since missed two consecutive games. The forward's final opportunity to suit up during the preseason will come Friday against Chicago.

name: Otega Oweh
short_comment: Oweh (Achilles) underwent surgery Wednesday and will miss the entirety of the 2026-27 season, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.
long_comment: Oweh exited Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers with a non-contact injury that was later diagnosed as a ruptured right Achilles tendon. The No. 41 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft already faced an uphill battle for playing time on a loaded Thunder roster and will now miss his entire rookie campaign. Depending on his recovery progress, Oweh could be a candidate to participate in the 2027 Summer League.

name: Luka Garza
short_comment: Garza (nose) went to the locker room late in the fourth quarter of Saturday's preseason game against the 76ers, Bobby Manning of CLNS Media Network reports.
long_comment: Garza took an inadvertent elbow to the nose from teammate Chris Cenac, and the former was taken to the locker room shortly thereafter. Assuming Garza doesn't return, he'll end his night with eight points (4-9 FG), seven rebounds and one assist over 11 minutes.

name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
short_comment: Shannon (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Knicks.
long_comment: Shannon will be unavailable at Madison Square Garden after starting Saturday against the Heat. Across three preseason games, the wing is averaging 11.3 points, 3.3 assists and 2.7 rebounds in 18.5 minutes per contest.

name: Julian Strawther
short_comment: Strawther (knee) will undergo an MRI on Thursday morning, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.
long_comment: Strawther exited to the locker room in the third quarter of Wednesday's loss to the Clippers after his left knee bent awkwardly following contact while handling the ball. "All you can do is hope for the best," said Nuggets head coach David Adelman. An extended absence for Strawther would test Denver's depth on the wing with Spencer Jones (hamstring) not yet cleared for contact.

name: Santi Aldama
short_comment: Aldama is unlikely to suit up for Friday's preseason finale against Atlanta, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.
long_comment: Coach Dusty May said Thursday that Aldama is getting "much, much closer" to returning but doesn't expect him to play against the Hawks. Dallas could continue leaning on its other frontcourt options until Aldama is cleared to return.

name: Marcus Sasser
short_comment: Sasser (groin) is expected to play in Friday's preseason finale against Atlanta, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

name: Kristaps Porzingis

Kelly Oubre and Ben Sheppard could see additional opportunities on the wing if Nesmith's absence extends into the regular season.

name: Jonathan Isaac

long_comment: Isaac previously missed time during the preseason due to personal reasons but has since rejoined the team on the court. The Magic now have their full roster participating in on-court activities.

name: Anthony Black
short_comment: Black (ankle) participated in Thursday's practice but remains in the process of ramping up his activity, according to Orlando Magic Daily.
long_comment: Black has been working his way back from a right ankle sprain, and his participation in practice marks another step toward a return to game action. However, his availability for Friday's preseason finale against Miami remains uncertain. Orlando may elect to take a cautious approach with the guard ahead of the regular season.

name: Anfernee Simons
short_comment: Simons (hamstring) is out for Friday's preseason game against the Celtics, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.
long_comment: Simons is trending in the right direction and was able to practice in full Thursday. The 76ers will take a cautious approach for the final exhibition, however.

name: Adem Bona
short_comment: Bona (foot) remains out for Friday's preseason finale against the Celtics, but he's getting closer to a return, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.
long_comment: Bona has yet to appear in the preseason and will now miss the final exhibition. He did go through practice Thursday, however, giving him a chance to suit up for Opening Night as the backup center.

name: Luke Kennard
short_comment: Kennard experienced soreness in his left knee during Wednesday's preseason game, Amanda Pflugrad of 3TV Phoenix reports.
long_comment: Coach Jordan Ott said following the game that Kennard was in good spirits despite the discomfort, and the team will evaluate how his knee responds Friday. The severity of the issue remains unclear, making his status worth monitoring as the regular season approaches.

name: Dylan Cardwell
short_comment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.
long_comment: Cardwell appeared in 44 games last season, providing frontcourt depth while Domantas Sabonis dealt with injuries. Sacramento will also be without Maxime Raynaud (knee) to begin the campaign, leaving the team thin at center behind Sabonis. Cardwell's return timetable remains uncertain, but his absence could create additional opportunities for the Kings' remaining frontcourt reserves.

name: Maxime Raynaud
short_comment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

name: Ja'Kobe Walter

name: Jamal Shead

name: Jakob Poeltl

name: Zach LaVine

name: Kyle Kuzma

name: Domantas Sabonis

name: Ben Simmons

name: Jarred Vanderbilt
short_comment: Vanderbilt (undisclosed) isn't expected to play in Friday's preseason game against the Nuggets, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

name: Dominick Barlow
